about_the_game:
The first hunt means everything to a Ruan.

Sun Rise Of The Time: End Of Blue tells the action-filled and adventurous story of Gilens in a beautifully crafted 2D world. The trial known as The Hunt is just a small part of this journey. It represents the test Gilens must pass to be considered an adult and a soldier in Ruan society.

In this game, every action matters. We’ve designed the world to be as free and unrestricted as possible. If you head in the wrong direction, you may unexpectedly encounter the drunken and unpredictable Kiger. Each encounter with Kiger plays out differently depending on where and how you meet him.

Combat in the game is real-time and reflex-based. The enemies you face may be more challenging than you expect — but it's possible to complete the game without killing any of them. However, defeating them grants you extra power and advantages as the story progresses.

Key Features

  • Genre: 2D Action-Adventure

  • Choice-Based Narrative: A branching storyline shaped by player decisions

  • Dialogue Tree: Interactive conversations with multiple outcomes

  • Multiple Endings: Your choices affect how the story concludes

  • Free Exploration: Open-ended map navigation

  • Hidden Areas: Secret zones to discover across the world

  • Collectibles: Story-related items and power-enhancing objects

  • Real-Time Combat: Skill-based close-quarters battle system

  • Light & Heavy Attacks: Use strategic combos to defeat different enemies

  • Dodge and Counter Mechanics: Avoid damage and strike back effectively

  • Inventory System: Track and use collected items for survival

A vast world stands before you. Complete the Hunt and unlock the gate.
In these lands painted crimson by the Ruans, time is lost.
Now it’s up to you to bring it back into the light.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains combat scenes with violence and blood effects, as well as themes involving alcohol use. Some dialogue or events may include mature or sensitive content.
